payload.description:
Purpose: New behavior for evaluating the scanner through local Plexus is specified as executable Gherkin. Production code exists only to make those scenarios pass.

Existing Jest (`tests/unit/**/*.spec.ts` and `tests/eval/**/*.test.ts`) stays for the current scanner and fixture-eval harness. This epic does not convert that suite. It adds a Gherkin runner and holds the chore to wire it.

Plexus and Virtuus already treat `.feature` files as the spec. DataParade should do the same for this initiative.

Definition of Done:
- A Gherkin runner exists in this repo
- Stories under DATAP-bd3b69 have matching `.feature` files before implementation
- `pnpm test` still runs Jest; features have their own command
payload.title: Prove Plexus-backed eval with executable Gherkin
